system.description:
You slip into the spaces between moments; to you the world seems to slow almost to a standstill while you move on unhindered.

Spend a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait to activate, then one Blood Trait per turn to maintain it. You gain an automatically successful free attack against anyone lacking Advanced Celerity, plus an extra action — taken before opponents with Advanced Celerity, or after those with Celerity powers of your own tier. Attacks from anyone with less than Advanced Celerity fail against you automatically unless you stand still, and only those with Advanced Celerity or higher may attempt to stop you or your Fair Escape.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait to activate, one per turn to maintain
system.duration: Sustained, one turn per Blood Trait spent
